subject: Sujatha S Iyer
identity_matching_rule: Include Sujatha S Iyer, Sujatha Iyer, Sujatha S, Sujatha, and obvious spelling/transcription variants only when ManageEngine, Zoho, Zoho Corporation, the AI-security role, or inventor/assignee context makes the identity unambiguous. Patent searches include Indian Patent Office/InPASS and US/international patent sources.

records.title: Text Watermarking Using Bitstream Encoding - US Patent No. 12,730,864
records.outlet: United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO)
records.summary: US Patent No. 12,730,864 B2 was granted to Zoho Corporation Private Limited for “Text Watermarking Using Bitstream Encoding.” The patent names Sujatha S Iyer among the inventors and describes embedding an identifier into text by encoding a bitstream through controlled changes to typographic properties, enabling recovery of the identifier from a leaked document.

records.title: ManageEngine: Philippine banks need continuous cyber visibility as AI speeds up attacks
records.summary: An exclusive interview on how AI is compressing the attack lifecycle for Philippine banks and why defenses need continuous, context-aware visibility. Sujatha discusses risk-based vulnerability prioritization, compensating controls and virtual patching for legacy systems, just-in-time privileged access, behavior analytics for compromised administrator accounts, AI-assisted human judgment, and operational metrics such as exposure coverage, blast radius and containment time.

records.title: International Women in Cyber Day 2026 – industry perspectives

records.title: Quantum readiness starts before Q-Day — An Asia Pacific perspective

records.outlet: The Patent Office, Government of India

records.title: AI is writing the code, engineers still need the math
records.outlet: The Times of India · Times Techies
records.summary: A career-and-engineering feature arguing that generative AI can accelerate code production, but cannot replace mathematical judgment. Sujatha uses examples such as Fourier transforms, invisible watermarking and malware classification to show why engineers still need to choose algorithms, thresholds, metrics and trade-offs deliberately.

records.title: Data Privacy and Security in the Age of Agentic AI
records.summary: A video-podcast discussion on securing autonomous agents. Sujatha covers agent identities, privilege escalation, tool and API access, data privacy, and the controls and guardrails needed before agents are trusted with enterprise actions. The page misspells her first name in one place but explicitly identifies her Zoho AI-security role.
records.status: verified – identity resolved by Zoho title despite spelling variant

records.title: Back to basics: Why math and coding matter in the AI era · #AICareerEdge Ep-13

records.title: Ep.1 – Security in the age of Agentic AI
records.summary: A recent discussion on why traditional security approaches need to evolve for autonomous AI agents. The indexed description identifies Sujatha as Head of AI (Security), Zoho Corporation and points to validation, scoped authority and stronger controls for agentic systems.

records.title: AI Appreciation Day: As enterprises embrace AI, the focus shifts from adoption to trust

records.title: The Success Of AI Will Ultimately Be Determined By Trust
records.summary: Sujatha argues that successful AI adoption depends on secure, transparent and well-governed IT foundations. The piece emphasizes trustworthy data, cybersecurity, visibility and human oversight rather than treating automation alone as the measure of AI success.

records.title: AI Appreciation Day 2026 – building trustworthy enterprise AI
records.summary: An industry roundup quoting Sujatha on visibility into data, security controls, accountable governance and human oversight as the foundations of trustworthy AI deployment.

records.title: One step ahead of agentic AI: The security team’s new playbook
records.summary: An authored playbook for securing agentic AI. It argues for privacy-first boundaries, a strong data-access permission layer, purpose-bound authorization, explainability, auditability and human review at high-impact checkpoints instead of relying on runtime prompts alone.

records.title: How can businesses respond to the next generation of AI?
records.summary: An authored analysis of how more capable AI models can accelerate and democratize cyberattacks. It calls for pre-emptive cyber resilience built on continuous monitoring, identity-first security, rapid response, patching and defensive use of AI.

records.title: AI Insights: ManageEngine’s Sujatha S Iyer
records.summary: A feature on production-grade enterprise AI and agentic systems. Sujatha discusses layered autonomy, scoped permissions, identity-aware access control, observability, data boundaries, fallback paths, failure containment, full-stack scalability and governance embedded in operations.

records.title: We ‘May’ have a lot to share this month 😉
records.summary: Zoho’s monthly bulletin highlights Sujatha’s journey from intern to head of AI security and points readers to her career reflection, ‘What AI research taught me about life.’ It emphasizes experimentation, learning and the path from early sentiment-analysis work to AI cyber-defense.

records.title: AI Security Hinges on Context-Aware Decisions
records.summary: A video interview from Cybersecurity Week Mumbai on why security decisions need business and identity context, not anomaly scores alone. records.title: Experts say Mythos is not a threat; instead, it is exposing how vulnerable enterprises already are
records.summary: A Fortune India feature on AI-assisted vulnerability discovery quotes Sujatha on the real shift being accessibility and speed rather than entirely new offensive capabilities. She warns that AI can lower the skill barrier for attackers and expands the security problem to non-human identities, service accounts and autonomous agents—making granular permissions and machine-identity governance critical.

records.title: The State of Workforce Password Security in 2026 – expert commentary
records.summary: Zoho’s workforce password-security campaign is promoted with Sujatha as the AI security expert unpacking risks and practical actions for IT leaders. The underlying report focuses on credential sprawl, authentication risk, passkeys and the path toward unified identity security.

records.title: Inside AI’s Cybersecurity Nightmare: How Agentic AI, Phishing & Malware Are Outpacing Human Oversight
records.summary: An in-depth interview on the shift from static rule-based defenses to behavior-driven AI security. Sujatha discusses phishing, malware, insider threats, agentic AI, data and access boundaries, patching, regulation, education and why human oversight remains non-negotiable.

records.title: Anthropic AI's Mythos triggers warnings over cyber risk
records.summary: Coverage of Anthropic Mythos quotes Sujatha on AI lowering the skill barrier for cybercriminals and accelerating reconnaissance, phishing and vulnerability discovery. records.title: AI Is Redefining Cybersecurity: Why Data Integrity, Not Perimeters, Is the Future of Digital Defense

site.name: Sujatha S Iyer
site.intro: I work at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, building practical, privacy-focused AI capabilities for enterprise use. My work spans threat detection and mitigation, user and entity behavior analytics, product security, and responsible AI deployment in production.
about: My work sits at the intersection of artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and enterprise software. I have spent more than a decade at Zoho working across AI research, engineering and production systems.

I am particularly interested in AI security, agentic systems, behavioural analytics, anomaly detection, causal reasoning, privacy-preserving AI and the engineering choices required to make models reliable at enterprise scale.

focus.title: Right-sized AI
focus.text: Models and architectures chosen for the actual enterprise problem, deployment constraints and cost.

focus.title: Context before autonomy
focus.text: AI systems grounded in business context, permissions, identity and auditable data boundaries.

focus.title: Security by design
focus.text: Privacy, access control, observability and governance built into AI systems from the start.

focus.title: Production over demos
focus.text: Research translated into reliable, scalable capabilities with measurable operational outcomes.
